scope: Recovered source lock and selection policy. Does not change storefront assignments or mark every assembly approved.
decision: Existing GPT master bodies for the paper-doll architecture first; product page and standalone configurator must resolve the same selected body. Grid migration is separate.

sourceProof.intent: Source-of-truth glass bodies for the catalogue
sourceProof.approvalScope: I approve all the approvable ones; existing holds remain held.

scale.userDecision: Later catalog-wide curve, with approved family exceptions

curve.input: bare glass height in mm, foot to rim
curve.output: shoulder or closure-seat span as percent of 10:11 canvas

rules: One immutable selected image hash per body identity and glass color. No separate body per cap, sprayer or roller.
Keep high-resolution source files; apply uniform scale from the approved shoulder/full-glass landmark to the fixed baseline.
Use the catalog curve fitted to five reference bodies, with family exceptions. Do not round every bottle into five buckets.
One body transform across product page and builder, color variants and assembly views. Fitment offsets may change; body placement does not.
Preserve later measured geometry and accepted local corrections. Older art cannot automatically replace them.
Clear/Swirl historical bodies have a bone-colored interior; do not multiply a second time. Tubes require prepared optical/occlusion layers.
Source-byte verification is separate from assembly visual QA. Preserve readiness holds.
